reason: This PR changes core executor join logic in IndexHashJoin/IndexLookupJoin and also touches shared chunk storage/container code. An 'incremental probing' change is likely a nontrivial runtime-behavior change with potential wrong-result, missed-row, duplicate-row, ordering, memory-lifecycle, or concurrency regressions in a central execution path, so it is important and risky enough for a blocker/high-focused deep review.
